credentials.guide.gitSshKey.step1: Add the dedicated public key to your code hosting account with write permission as needed

credentials.guide.codeBuddy.step2: Select the matching network environment under "Personal settings → CodeBuddy API Key", paste the key and save; third-party keys like DeepSeek do not work here

1. Confirm the scope and goals for this addition
2. List specific changes and open questions
3. Check acceptance criteria and keep follow-up notes

- Confirm the target outcome
- List the concrete details to adjust
- Verify against clear acceptance criteria

Feel free to add more details or tell me what to prioritize.
